pairs.locus: Piccolomini, Epistula ad Procopium de Rabenstein (Somnium de Fortuna)
pairs.question: Quenam est hec domina, cujus expectatur vocatio?
pairs.answer: Hera Fortuna, cujus munere omnes, qui sumus hic, feliciter vivimus.
pairs.derivation: Aeneas asks Vegius about the awaited mistress. Answer drops the framing 'respondit Vegius' and normalizes the capital H; the operative answering sentence runs to the first full stop ('feliciter vivimus.'); what follows ('illi totus obedit orbis...') is elaboration and is cut.

pairs.locus: Piccolomini, Epistula ad Procopium de Rabenstein (Somnium de Fortuna)
pairs.question: Qui sunt hi, obsecro, sedentes viri, reverentia digni subtristesque?
pairs.answer: Hi sunt, quos hec domina ab initio nascentis mundi dignata est magnos facere.
pairs.derivation: Aeneas asks Vegius about the seated translucent shades. Answer drops the framing 'inquit Vegius' and ends at the first full stop ('magnos facere.'); what follows ('sed jam satis functi huc venerunt...') is elaboration and is cut.

pairs.locus: Piccolomini, Epistula ad Procopium de Rabenstein (Somnium de Fortuna)
pairs.question: Quenam horum fortuna est omnium?
pairs.answer: Bona, si tuus herus fortune vocibus auscultaverit, varia si obaudiverit.
pairs.derivation: Aeneas asks Vegius about the fortune of the assembled living men. Answer drops the framing 'inquit Vegius' and normalizes the capital B; runs to the full stop ('obaudiverit.'); the next sentence ('dum famur, video parva statura virum...') resumes the narrative and is cut.

pairs.locus: Piccolomini, Epistula ad Procopium de Rabenstein (Somnium de Fortuna)
pairs.question: Video togatos quosdam, quinam sunt hi?
pairs.derivation: Aeneas asks Vegius about the toga-clad figures. Setup 'Video togatos quosdam' is kept verbatim so 'hi' has a referent. Answer drops the framing 'inquit Vegius' and ends at the first full stop ('meus pontifex.'); what follows ('num Eugenium nosti?') is a new question and is cut.

pairs.locus: Piccolomini, Epistula ad Procopium de Rabenstein (Somnium de Fortuna)
pairs.question: Quis te huc accersivit, Enea?
pairs.answer: Nemo, sed avidus te visendi introgressus sum.
pairs.derivation: Fortuna challenges Aeneas. Question drops the inline speech tag 'inquit'. Answer drops 'inquam ego', normalizes the capital N, and runs to the full stop ('introgressus sum.'); what follows ('noli mihi succensere...') is a further plea and is cut.

pairs.locus: Piccolomini, Epistula ad Procopium de Rabenstein (Somnium de Fortuna)
pairs.question: Quamdiu es hominibus blanda?
pairs.derivation: First of Fortuna's rapid-fire replies to Aeneas. Answer drops the framing 'respondit' and normalizes the capital N; ends at the full stop before the next question ('iterum ego:').
